bluetooth_confirm.title: iDotMatrix Display Found
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} to Home Assistant?

discovery.title: Select Device
discovery.description: Select your iDotMatrix device from the list below, or choose manual entry if your device is not listed.

manual.title: Add Device Manually
manual.description: Enter your iDotMatrix device information manually.

configure.title: Configure {name}
configure.description: Select the pixel resolution of your iDotMatrix display. Check the back of the device or the original packaging — most IDM- devices are 32×32.

error.no_devices_found: No iDotMatrix devices found. Make sure your device is powered on and in pairing mode.
error.scan_failed: Failed to scan for devices. Check that Bluetooth is enabled.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Use format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress

init.title: iDotMatrix Options
init.description: Configure options for your iDotMatrix device.

show_icon_message.name: Show icon & message
show_icon_message.description: Shows an icon in the top part of the display with text below. Text that fits is shown still; longer text scrolls back and forth. Also updates the Icon & Message entities.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An MDI icon. In YAML this can also be a local file path (/config/www/icons/home.png) or an http(s) image URL.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text shown below the icon. Supports templates.

text_color.name: Text color
text_color.description: Leave empty to keep the current text color. In YAML also [r, g, b] or a preset name (red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, white, orange, purple, pink).

icon_color.name: Icon color
icon_color.description: MDI icons only. Leave empty to keep the current icon color. In YAML also [r, g, b] or a preset name.

restore_after.name: Restore after
restore_after.description: Return to what was on screen before after this time. Leave empty to keep showing it.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Shows scrolling text. Also updates the Text: Message entity.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to show. Supports templates.

color.name: Color
color.description: Leave empty to keep the current text color. In YAML also [r, g, b] or a preset name.

font_size.name: Font size
font_size.description: Leave empty to keep the current font size.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Scroll speed. Leave empty to keep the current speed.

restore_after.name: Restore after
restore_after.description: Return to what was on screen before after this time. Leave empty to keep showing it.

start_countdown.name: Start countdown
start_countdown.description: Starts the countdown on the display (up to 59:59).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to count down, up to 59 minutes 59 seconds.

restore_after.name: Restore after
restore_after.description: Return to what was on screen before this long after the countdown has ended. Leave empty to stay on the countdown.

set_scoreboard.name: Set scoreboard
set_scoreboard.description: Shows the scoreboard with both scores in one update.

home.name: Home
home.description: Home score (0–999). Leave empty to keep the current score.

away.name: Away
away.description: Away score (0–999). Leave empty to keep the current score.

no_target_display.message: No loaded iDotMatrix display found in the selected target.

action_failed.message: Failed to update {device}. Check that the display is in range and connected.
